facts.fact: 用点和划写成的道歉叫什么？Remorse code——remorse（悔恨）与 Morse code（摩斯码）同音
facts.anchor: What do you call an apology written in dots and dashes? Remorse code.

facts.fact: 直升机发明俱乐部的成员讨论打扫分工，我说“也许该搞个 rota system（轮值表）”，众人齐喊“我们知道！”——rota 谐音 rotor（旋翼），直升机的事他们当然懂
facts.anchor: All of us at Try To Invent A Helicopter Club have been attempting to figure out how best to make sure everyone does their fair share of cleaning. I said, ‘Perhaps we should have a rota system,’ and they all said, ‘YES WE KNOW.’

facts.fact: 外号“人形电脑”：不是因为聪明，而是一没人理就十分钟内睡着——电脑待机休眠
facts.anchor: My nickname is ‘the human computer’. Not because I’m smart, but because I go to sleep if left alone for ten minutes.

facts.fact: 爱尔兰技术为什么用双重认证？To be sure, to be sure——爱尔兰口音的强调说法，也字面指“两次确认”
facts.anchor: Why does Irish technology involve two-factor authorization? To be sure, to be sure.

facts.fact: 在梵蒂冈最好的付款方式是 PayPal decree——papal decree（教皇诏令）被换成 PayPal
facts.anchor: The best way to pay for things in Vatican City is by PayPal decree.

facts.fact: 别用 beef stew 当密码：它 isn’t stroganoff——strong enough 谐音 Stroganoff（奶油蘑菇牛肉）
facts.anchor: Why shouldn’t you use ‘beef stew’ as a computer password? It isn’t stroganoff.

facts.fact: 初学打字的人为什么摘不下帽子？caps lock 开着——大写锁定／帽子（caps）锁住
facts.anchor: Why couldn’t the beginner typists remove their hats? They had caps lock on.

facts.fact: 手机为什么戴眼镜？它丢了 contacts——联系人／隐形眼镜
facts.anchor: Why was the mobile phone wearing glasses? Because it lost its contacts.

facts.fact: 在网上买了深色酸味面包：a site for sour ryes——site for sore eyes（让人看了舒服的东西）谐音，sour rye 是酸黑麦面包
facts.anchor: I bought some dark, vinegary bread online. Boy, was that a site for sour ryes.

facts.fact: 手机电脑确实一直监视你，但最糟的不是它们：你的吸尘器已经收集你的脏东西好多年——gather dirt 双关“收集灰尘／收集黑料”
facts.anchor: Sure, your phone and computer spy on you all the time, but they’re not the worst. Your hoover has been gathering dirt on you for years.
